Maya (Design): Doing a focused accessibility pass on the Settings panel (toggles + helpers + keyboard). Quick summary of issues and fixes.

Ravi (Frontend): thanks, drop the list here and well triage.

Maya (Design): 1) Toggle semantics: screen readers read "button" twice. Suggest `role="switch" aria-checked="true|false" aria-labelledby="id"` so SRs announce state succinctly.

Jamal (QA): confirmed on NVDA/VoiceOver. Current markup says "button", then label, then "button". Using role=switch fixes the wording to "Notifications, on/off".

Maya (Design): 2) Helper text (quota note under API keys) isn't linked to the input. Add `aria-describedby` to ensure SR users hear the helper.

Eli (Eng): For responsive: visible helper on desktop, on mobile we can visually collapse but keep it in DOM and referenced by `aria-describedby`.

Ravi (Frontend): noted. Will use a single id per helper and ensure uniqueness.

Maya (Design): 3) Focus outline clipped by overflow:hidden on the card container. Options: make container overflow visible or add `outline-offset` on focused control.

Jamal (QA): Keyboard users lose the ring when tabbing across sections after last layout change.

Ravi (Frontend): I'll try outline-offset first to avoid DOM moves; fallback to container style if needed.

Maya (Design): 4) Contrast: disabled toggle thumb fails AA. accessibility-bot ran a check.

accessibility-bot: Contrast result: #cfcfcf on #f0f0f0 -> 2.0:1 (fail). Recommendation: #9e9e9e on #f0f0f0 -> 4.5:1 (pass).

Sophie (Product): Make sure disabled still reads as disabled visually.

Maya (Design): Slightly darker thumb + lower opacity keeps the visual cue. I'll push a Figma patch.

Ravi (Frontend): Plan: change toggle role/aria, add aria-describedby, CSS outline-offset + updated disabled color, add unit tests + axe checks. Estimate 3-4 engineer-days.

Jamal (QA): I'll add VoiceOver/NVDA test steps to the regression checklist and run keyboard-only flows in the release branch.

Sophie (Product): Flagging as P1 for the upcoming Dedicated release. Please target a merge before the freeze.

Ravi (Frontend): assigning to me. Draft PR by EOD tomorrow, target merge Wed.

Maya (Design): thanks all 64f 49a. Ping me on the PR for UX review and I'll update the UX handbook pattern for switch controls.

accessibility-bot: Reminder: run `npm run a11y:ci` in the PR to surface regressions.

Eli (Eng): Great. I'll watch the PR for any backend hooks that may be affected by attribute changes.
